cells.value: A pipe section with one or more bends formed through localized heating and controlled working without a mandrel on a machine specifically designed for that purpose.
A pipe section curved to a centerline radius of 1 1/2 times the nominal pipe diameter.

All fittings of the same type and maximum wall thickness (or schedule) that are produced from the same heat of steel and subjected to the same finishing (i.e., heat treatment, amount of working, and welding procedure). Heat treatment may be in multiple furnace loads providing all temperatures are controlled within ±50 °F.
A pipe section formed through heating and controlled forming over a mandrel.
Multiple heats for which, all of the reported elements are within ±10 percent of the mean. Where noted, matched heats, which are subjected to the same finishing, may be grouped into a single lot.
A pipe section curved to a centerline radius of 1 times the nominal pipe diameter
